audit.whatIsWrong: Even-to-favoured framing with a Swain win condition throughout is consistent with the kits.
audit.why: Tahm's engage (W) is slow and telegraphed, his all-in needs 3 Tongue Lash stacks, and his peel (E/R) is single-target — Swain's root-drain profile beats that shape at every stage.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0-6].side all read "Skill" while content win[0-6] all read "Swain" — every row of the full-layer chart disagrees with the content-layer chart and with the whys text.
audit.why: whys[0-6] and early/mid/late all describe Swain winning every stage; win[] and the packet.levelChart already agree with that (Swain x7). Only the full-layer side column is stale.
audit.corrected: Move phases[0-6].side to Swain across the board; the existing why text already argues Swain's side correctly, so no why rewrites are needed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Tahm's Q/E sustain (Grievous Wounds timing) and his E/R shields absorbing burst are both flagged as applicable but unstated.
audit.why: Tongue Lash heals him on hit and Thick Skin banks grey-health regen, so anti-heal timing matters; Thick Skin's active shield and Devour both absorb a burst window, so it needs to be forced out before an all-in.
audit.corrected: Folded both into the two bleed-fix rewrites below since those fields were already being touched for the lint fix.

edits.before: E the carrier, pull the fragment, Q the formation — one root taxed three bars and healed yours.
edits.after: Every E root drops a Soul Fragment — grab it, and lead with anti-heal so his Tongue Lash sustain stops paying him back.

edits.before: Brawling pre-6 at marksman range — the demon era has a start date; respect it.
edits.after: His Thick Skin shield banks free damage — force it out with poke before you commit to the all-in.

edits.before: - Tahm Kench Abyssal Dive: matchup-defining — His re-engage and his escape — all-in only while it is down. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep E Nevermove banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Tahm Kench's Abyssal Dive is back every 17-21s — his re-engage and his escape, all-in only while it is down. - Your E Nevermove cools at 12s early, 10s maxed — bank it for his dive. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.

notes: All seven phases[N].side were flat "Skill" and contradicted the already-correct content win[] (Swain x7) — fixed by moving every side to Swain; the existing why text already supported that side so no why rewrites were needed. Fixed both copy-paste-bleed bullets (folding in the needs-antiheal and shield-absorbs-burst missing interactions) and added real cooldown numbers to breakdown.cooldowns. No misgender issues here (Tahm Kench is he/him, already correct).
